register_env: register a new gym environment with an id, entry point, and max episode steps
make_env: make a gym environment instance from a registered environment id with optional kwargs
get_env_spec: get the EnvSpec for a registered environment id from the global registry
load_entry_point: load a Python class or function from a module:attribute string using importlib
patch_deprecated_methods: patch deprecated underscore-prefixed methods on a gym environment for backward compatibility
